title: SSQR 外部复现实验环境与参数

pages.title: 实验环境
pages.intro: 本材料集中列出主稿三个研究问题及相关敏感性实验的环境和参数。表 S16—S25 接续既有补充结果表 S1—S15；同一参数在不同实验中的取值分别保留。依据列 R01—R35 对应随附来源索引。

rows: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU；运行记录显存 8,151 MiB
AMD Ryzen 9 8945HX with Radeon Graphics；16 核、32 逻辑处理器（本次硬件核对）
主 T5、CodeBERT 及有限训练对照使用 BF16；有限对照模型权重为 FP32

tables.title: 八种预算匹配训练配置
notes: 依据 R15、R16、R30。全部从同一 T5-base 初始化，共用固定 32,768 行训练材料和数据顺序，进行 1,024 次更新；微批量 8、累积 4、有效批量 32、初始学习率 0.001、梯度范数上限 1；BF16 计算、FP32 权重。

R27.scope: Selected verifier functions; original bodies unchanged; original source identity retained for provenance

R34.scope: current hardware recheck; CPU and RAM not recorded in historic run metadata

CQC_T5.masking: dynamic per epoch; one contiguous span of round(15% words), minimum 1

CodeBERT.best_checkpoint: selected only by CodeXGLUE valid source full MRR, never CoSQA
CodeBERT.sampler: explicit torch.randperm CPU generator; seed=123456+epoch; saved next_batch
CodeBERT.paper_source_choice: published CodeBERT objective and source linear schedule; paper constant-LR discrepancy recorded
CodeBERT.runtime_difference: modern PyTorch/transformers, bf16 and layer activation checkpointing; full BxB objective unchanged

finite_training_common.initialization: same original t5-base; no continuation from adapted model
finite_training_common.data_order: fixed shared bank; no arm-specific shuffle/corruption

UniXcoder_inference.pooling: mean of all nonpadding last hidden token states including special tokens
UniXcoder_inference.similarity: FP32 dot product of normalized vectors
UniXcoder_inference.ties: score descending, original corpus doc_id ascending

H_risk.algorithm: threeway zero-reference offset logistic; historical algorithm adapted to20real stage/anchor features
H_risk.training: separateD risk role; actual selected actions after exact25%verification allocation; no class weights
H_risk.penalty: intercept1, verified coefficient50, other coefficients10; duplicate CEavailability masked
H_risk.fallback: restore original fullTop100; no reject-and-reselect; retain sunkCEcost
H_risk.certification: no certificate from dependent query-level binomial counts; cluster intervals are descriptive

H_verification.budget: highest positive base-gain priority min(floor(n/4),eligible) queries per retriever, queryID breaks ties
H_verification.plan: eight distinct original success anchors, winner/rival and largest RR-position changes; public rankings only
H_verification.scorer: frozen historical real code-query CE; original userquery conditioning; source training exposure retained
H_verification.input: query<=64 tokens, code<=160 tokens plus actual model specials
H_verification.update: separate-role weighted Ridge residual on71+2+18real witness features; mean+=.5residual; same ENTR pool, NoRewrite0

hardware_recheck.scope: current hardware recheck; CPU and RAM not recorded in historic run metadata
